method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited texts with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the tax-and-benefits brief of 24 Oct 2026; a seat-neutral core (lta-core.l4 for land tax, rcr-core.l4 for the rates remission, shared nouns in lt-common.l4) holding 10 regulative rules, and a seat layer (lta-seat.l4, 32 exported questions) that restates no rule; no REFUSE (land tax before 2026-27, a remission year before 2024-25, or a missing CPI figure answers `not covered`, asserted); checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Land Tax Act 2000 (Tas), act-2000-074, consolidation published 2026-10-14, deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/act-2000-074.txt; brought in: Land Tax Rating Act 2000, act-2000-073, published 2024-07-12; Land Tax Regulations 2021, sr-2021-096, published 2021-12-01; Local Government (Rates and Charges Remissions) Act 1991, act-1991-008, published 2019-05-23; Local Government (Rates and Charges Remissions) Regulations 2024, sr-2024-055, published 2024-10-16 (each deposited in its own sibling subject); all current at point in time 2026-10-20. Land tax answered from 2026-27 (ss 13 and 37 amended from 1 July 2026, earlier wording not deposited); the rates remission from 2024-25. Inputs: the land value (s 23), the Hobart CPI March-quarter figures (reg 5; illustrative figures in the cases); penalties in penalty units.

checks.result: 335 assertions written, 335 satisfied (134 land tax core, 97 rates remission core, 104 seat), 0 errors, 0 warnings (2026-10-24); 11 #TRACEs with an expect line (6 breaches, 5 obligations pending), each read and as expected; a control copy with one expected value altered failed as it should

scope: OWNING A HOME: the yearly State land tax and the pensioner remission of council rates, from the seat of the owner. Land Tax Act 2000: ss 3, 3A(1)-(2), 3B, 11A (owner and interest); s 6(1), (2), (8), (9)-(12); ss 7, 8; s 10(1)-(2) with s 39(10); s 11(3); s 13 (regulative); s 14(1)-(2); s 16 (regulative); s 19(a)-(b) with Land Tax Regulations 2021 reg 5; ss 20, 23, 24(1)-(1A); ss 26 (with s 3 qualifying home business), 27; s 37 (regulative); s 37A (regulative); s 37B. Land Tax Rating Act 2000 ss 4-7 and Schedule 1. Local Government (Rates and Charges Remissions) Act 1991 s 3, s 4(1)-(9) (s 4(1)-(1A) and s 4(9) regulative), ss 4A, 4B, 4C, 4E, 4F (regulative); Regulations 2024 regs 4, 5, 6. Out: foreign investor land tax (Div 1A, Rating Act s 6A); trusts, companies, home-unit companies, cooperative housing societies (s 6(3)-(5), ss 24(2)-(4), 28, 30-35, Div 5); Crown, trust, retirement village and other exempt land (ss 17, 18, 19(ba)-(e), 19A-19EA, 29, 30A); subdivisions; s 12; the special rate (s 38); recovery (ss 39-40 save s 39(10)); reg 4 of the Land Tax Regulations; the Taxation Administration Act 1997; Remissions Act ss 4D, 4G-4I, 5, 6, 8. The Remissions Act and Regulations are encoded here, not in a folder of their own.
seat: the owner of land who pays council rates: an individual home owner, joint owner, owner of a shack or investment land, and a pensioner or a pensioner's surviving spouse
